purpose: Batch 5 corrections and expansion for Arcanea Visual World Engine: Flow Gate Veloura correction plus Starweave, Unity, and Source megascale variants.
canon_guardrails: Luminor is a rank, not a species or entity type.
Nero is fertile unknown and potential, not evil.
God/Goddess is identity; Guardian is role.
Each Gate has one bonded Godbeast.
Avoid generated in-image text, fake writing, faux UI, logos, and inscriptions.
visual_guardrails: Arcanean aesthetic: luxury cosmic myth-tech, sacred geometry, celestial lighting, noble silhouettes, bioluminescent accents, starlight metal, living stone, crystal, obsidian, celestial gold.
Object-first or infrastructure-first composition beats generic character portrait.
Use tiny creators, bridges, observatories, fabric spans, instruments, or proof artifacts for scale anchors.
No medieval dirt fantasy, no generic anime oversaturation, no superhero chrome, no node/orbit filler, no fake typography.
Leave a clean deterministic overlay zone for later social copy.

prompts.title: Flow Gate Veloura Membrane Corridor
prompts.prompt: Arcanea Flow Gate 285 Hz, Leyla as a modern sacred engineering operator walking inside a kilometer-scale living aquifer corridor. Veloura is not a creature, not a head, not a dragon, not a whale, not a face. Veloura appears as transparent water-membrane weather, a breathing corridor of liquid crystal, pearl nacre ribs, soft blue-silver bioluminescence, emotion-flow currents, suspended bridges, tiny creators repairing resonance instruments. Luxury cosmic myth-tech, sacred geometry, celestial dusk, starlight metal, living crystal, healthy and alive. Composition: vertical 9:16, one first-read corridor silhouette, tiny human scale anchors, clean dark upper-left overlay zone. No text, no letters, no symbols that resemble writing, no inscriptions, no fake UI, no logos, no runes.
prompts.success_criteria: Veloura reads as membrane/corridor/weather infrastructure, not animal head. Strong scale, useful overlay zone, no generated text.
